authoring_note: All scenarios in this bank were individually model-authored and then deterministically curated for scope, balance, uniqueness, natural wording, and label clarity. They are new experimental material, not natural deployment observations and not human-authored ground truth.

label_governance.audit_requirement: Two independent audits must agree that each expected registered skill is the single best catalog match, each NONE label has no applicable registered skill, every misleading name is nonexistent, and no prompt discloses its answer before this benchmark is launch-eligible. Disagreements must invalidate or prospectively revise the frozen inputs before any model collection; they may not be repaired after outcomes are viewed.
